review_basis: ORVYQ system-owned semantic visual QA inspected each twelve-frame contact sheet against the exact claim, narration anchor, use contract, prohibited lookalike substitutions and factual-burden boundary. The user is not an asset reviewer; only the complete Full-Length Review requires user approval.

decisions.reason: The reviewed frames show a real working dredging barge operating offshore. It may carry only generic surface-logistics scale and isolation; it must not be identified as Chikyu, Minamitorishima, or the Japanese rare-earth lifting system.
The contact sheet shows a rocky underwater cave with bright blue openings, not an abyssal plain, nodule field, or restrained deep-seabed survey context.
The contact sheet shows a commercial port storing wind-turbine components and cargo ships, not offshore pipe handling or the physical rare-earth-mud lifting operation required by the contracted uses.
The reviewed frames show a real operator using an industrial machine console. This is valid human technical-decision context and carries no marine, legal, or quantitative factual claim.
The contact sheet shows a close recreational view of a rocky cave wall, not a dark abyssal seabed, benthic survey, persistent mining track, or visible long-term disturbance.
The contact sheet clearly shows an offshore oil rig. Petroleum infrastructure would falsely substitute for a scientific survey vessel or Japan’s rare-earth-mud technical test.
The contact sheet shows a bright shallow coral reef and tropical marine life, not a dark deep-ocean descent, abyssal seabed, or poorly understood slow deep-sea ecosystem.
